orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND 
AT NAINITAL
ON THE 15TH DAY OF DECEMBER, 2021
BEFORE:
HON’BLE SHRI JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI
Writ Petition (M/S) No. 2710 of 2021
BETWEEN:
A.M.T. Builders Pvt. Ltd. …Petitioner
(By Mr. Shikhar Kacker, Advocate)
AND:
State of Uttarakhand and others …Respondents
(By Mr. J.S. Bisht, Standing Counsel for the State/respondent no.1 and 
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Davesh Bishnoi 
and Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, Advocate for respondent nos. 2 and 3.)
ORDER
This writ petition has been filed by a private 
limited company, which was denied registration as 
Contractor by respondent nos. 2 & 3 on the ground 
that it is not domiciled in Uttarakhand. Petitioner 
earlier approached this Court by filing Writ Petition 
(M/S) No. 2237 of 2021, which was allowed and the 
distinction made by Nagar Palika Parishad between 
contractors based on their domicile/residence was held 
to be bad and respondents were directed to reconsider 
petitioner’s application for registration, in accordance 
with law.
2. Now, petitioner has been registered by 
Nagar Palika Parishad, Mangloure, in a new category, 
namely, A+, which is meant for Contractors from 
outside the State and who are permitted to bid only, in 
respect of civil contracts above the value of ` 5 crores.
The Nagar Palika Parishad has issued a Notice Inviting 
Tender on 26.11.2021, in which, only Contractors 
registered in Class-A are permitted to participate. 
Since petitioner has been registered in A+ category,  2
therefore, petitioner apprehends that his bid will not 
be considered, on the ground that petitioner is not 
registered as Class-A Contractor. 
3. In the judgment rendered in Writ Petition 
(M/S) No. 2237 of 2021, the classification between 
Contractors made on the basis of domicile status has 
been held to be arbitrary. Even otherwise also, the 
bye-laws which has been relied upon by the Nagar 
Palika Parishad have not been notified in the official 
Gazette. In such view of the matter, a case is made 
out for grant of interim order. 
4. Learned counsel for the respondent prays 
for and is granted four weeks’ time for filing counter￾affidavit and two weeks’ thereafter is granted to the 
learned counsel for the petitioner for filing rejoinder￾affidavit. List this case after six weeks. 
5. In the meantime, petitioners bid submitted,
pursuant to Notice Inviting Tender dated 26.11.2021
shall not be rejected only on the ground that petitioner 
is not registered in ‘A’ category.
 
(MANOJ KUMAR TIWARI, J.) Shubham

notes.pros_title: Nagar Palika (aapke client) ke paksh mein

timeline.text: WPMS/2237/2021 allowed: domicile ke aadhaar par registration se inkaar quash, Nagar Palika 3 hafte mein dobara vichar kare
Nagar Palika ka NIT: sirf Class-A contractor. AMT ko 'A+' (bahar ke contractor, sirf 5 crore se upar) mein registration mila
WPMS/2710/2021: AMT ki bid sirf 'A' category na hone par radd nahi hogi (interim). Court ne kaha, jin bye-laws par Nagar Palika tiki hai, woh gazette mein nahi
WPMB/385/2025 + 433/2025: counter ke liye 'finally' 2 hafte, warna merits par disposal

WPMB/118/2026: DB ne do sawaal tay kiye (domicile par rok; category par chhote tender se rok). Contracts award ho chuke the, isliye successful bidders ko notice gaya. Award faisle ke adheen. Saare cases saath lagenge
M/s Sunrise Construction ko notice nahi pahuncha. Nagar Palika (respondent 3) 2 hafte mein khud serve kare
Respondents ko amendment application par objection ke liye 3 hafte
WPMB/878/2026 file hui, Nagar Palika caveator (Bhagwat Mehra)
Court No. 1 (Acting CJ + Justice Subhash Upadhyay), item 16 aur 16(1)–16(5) saath. Record mein agli tareekh 25.11.2026

pros: 25.02.2026: contracts par roak nahi lagi, sirf 'subject to the decision'. Kaam chal raha hai, aur successful bidders ab party hain. Poora hua kaam palatna mushkil hai (Silppi, para 21).
Kanwaljeet (para 16): employer financial capacity, experience aur past performance ki shartein laga sakta hai. Agar A/A+ category asal mein kaam ki keemat aur kshamta par hai, to yahi mukhya tark.
Afcons (para 15) aur Silppi (para 20): tender ki shartein aur unki vyakhya mein court ka dakhal seemit.
WPMS/2237/2021 ka faisla bina sanshodhan wale 2018 ke bye-laws par tika tha (para 16–17). Sanshodhit bye-laws gazette mein aa chuke hon to tathya alag.
cons: WPMS/2237/2021: same petitioner aur same Nagar Palika. Niwas ke aadhaar par bhed Article 14 ke khilaaf maana ja chuka hai (para 10).

Kanwaljeet: '5 crore se kam local, upar sab' wali lagbhag yahi shart quash ho chuki hai. 15.12.2021 ke order (para 2) mein A+ ko "Contractors from outside the State" ki category bataya gaya, yaani domicile ka hi roop.
15.12.2021: court ne kaha ki Nagar Palika jin bye-laws par tiki hai, woh gazette mein notify nahi.
Dono khilaaf faisle Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari ke hain, jo record ke anusaar abhi is Division Bench mein hain.
Counter der se gaya (IA/3, IA/4 delay condonation). 12.08.2025 ko court ne 'finally' samay diya tha.
todo: Sanshodhit bye-laws (A+ category) ki gazette notification aur State ki manzoori ki copy
A/A+ category kis aadhaar par: kaam ki keemat aur kshamta (capacity), ya niwas? Board resolution
IA/5/2026 (amendment) par objection file hui ya nahi? (13.08.2026 se 3 hafte)
M/s Sunrise Construction ko serve karne ka saboot (30.04.2026 ka order)
Award hue kaamon ki sthiti: kitna poora hua, kitna bhugtaan hua
Counter aur delay condonation (IA/3, IA/4) record par
notes.disclaimer: Ye vishleshan Claude ne court ke orders (15.12.2021 se 13.08.2026) aur judgments database se banaya hai. Bhagwat Mehra Nagar Palika Parishad Manglour (respondent) ki taraf se hain. Advocate ka review zaroori. Petition, counter aur bye-laws milne par aur gehra hoga. Koi jeetne ka % nahi.

similar.title: A.M.T. Builders v. State of Uttarakhand
similar.cite: WPMS/2237/2021 · 17.11.2021 · Allowed · Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
similar.why: Isi Nagar Palika ke khilaaf AMT jeet chuki hai: niwas ke aadhaar par contractors mein bhed Article 14 ke khilaaf. Par yeh 2018 ke bina sanshodhan wale bye-laws par tika tha (para 16–17).
similar.quote: “…discrimination amongst citizens for registration as Contractors by Nagar Palika Parishad, which is State under Article 12 of Constitution, based on their place of residence/place of birth would be impermissible.” (para 10)

similar.title: Kanwaljeet Singh Batra v. UK State Warehousing Corp.
similar.cite: WPMS/3816/2019 · 27.07.2021 · Allowed · Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
similar.why: '5 crore se kam ke tender sirf local' wali shart quash. Par para 16 mein maana gaya ki financial capacity, experience aur past performance ki shartein laga sakte hain.
similar.quote: “No doubt, the employer is free to lay down the conditions regarding financial capacity, work experience, past performance etc. of a bidder…” (para 16)

similar.title: Afcons Infrastructure v. Nagpur Metro Rail Corp.
similar.why: Tender likhne wala employer hi uski shartein sabse achhe se samajhta hai. Court sirf mala fide ya perversity par dakhal deta hai.
similar.quote: “…the owner or the employer of a project, having authored the tender documents, is the best person to understand and appreciate its requirements and interpret its documents.” (para 15)

similar.title: Silppi Constructions v. Union of India
similar.why: Tender maamlon mein court ka sanyam. Award ho chuke contract ki chunauti mein successful bidders ki maujoodgi zaroori (para 21).
similar.quote: “…the court must realise that the authority floating the tender is the best judge of its requirements and, therefore, the court's interference should be minimal.” (para 20)

notes.summary: AMT Builders ko 2237/2021 ke baad Nagar Palika ne 'A+' category (bahar ke contractor, sirf 5 crore se upar) mein registration diya. Phir 26.11.2021 ke NIT mein sirf Class-A contractor bulaye gaye. AMT ka kehna hai ki yeh domicile par wahi purana bhed hai. Bhagwat Mehra Nagar Palika aur uske Chairman (respondent 2, 3) ki taraf se hain.
notes.status: 15.12.2021 se interim order: AMT ki bid sirf 'A' category na hone par radd nahi hogi. 25.02.2026 ko DB ne ise CJ ke administrative order se Division Bench mein saath lagaane ko kaha. 13.08.2026: amendment application par objection ke liye 3 hafte. Record mein agli tareekh 25.11.2026.
